message.reasoning:
We need to simulate three experts but final answer is a single test file. Provide list of public methods, basic test cases, edge cases, etc. Then provide merged test file NodeTest.java with JUnit4. We need to mock concrete subclass of Node because Node is abstract. Use a minimal subclass for testing, maybe SimpleNode extends Node with minimal implementations: attributes, child list, baseUri, etc.

Need to import necessary jsoup classes? We can use org.jsoup.nodes.Element etc for more realistic behavior; but to keep independent, we can create a MinimalNode that extends Node, implement abstract methods using simple fields.

Implement nodeName returns "#test". hasAttributes returns true if attributes not null. attributes returns an Attributes object (use org.jsoup.nodes.Attributes). baseUri returns stored baseUri string. doSetBaseUri sets field. childNodeSize returns size of child list. ensureChildNodes returns list.

Implement outerHtmlHead and outerHtmlTail maybe just write something simple. For testing many methods we might not need outerHtml functionalities. However some methods like outerHtml call outerHtmlHead/Tail; we can implement simple behavior.

Simplify: In MinimalNode, outerHtmlHead appends "<node>" and outerHtmlTail appends "</node>".

Now test methods: attr, attr(key,value), hasAttr, removeAttr, clearAttributes, setBaseUri, absUrl, childNode, childNodes, childNodesCopy, parent, parentNode, root, ownerDocument, remove, before/after with html (requires Parser parseFragment; can use real Parser from jsoup). Could use real Element nodes to test before/after etc. But easier: test sibling insertion using before(Node) and after(Node). We'll need parent with children. Use MinimalNode as parent.

Edge cases: null arguments cause Validate.notNull to throw IllegalArgumentException? Validate class likely throws IllegalArgumentException. We'll assert that.

Test attr with missing attribute returns empty string. Test attr with "abs:" prefix returns empty if baseUri not set.

absUrl: test when attribute exists and is relative, baseUri set, resolves correctly.

Test childNode out of bounds throws IndexOutOfBoundsException.

Test siblingNodes when no parent returns empty list.

Test nextSibling and previousSibling.

Test replaceWith with null should throw.

Test wrap with null or empty html throws.

Test unwrap on node with no parent throws.

Test equals identity.

Test hasSameValue for same content.

Test clone produces deep copy independent.

Will produce many tests.

Now produce final test file with JUnit4 annotations, use @Test, expected exceptions.

Add helper class MinimalNode inside test file.
